idea-plugin.name: Comment Checker
idea-plugin.description:
Review changed comments before commit. Adds a Comments tab to the Commit tool window. It lists the comments on changed lines of the files shown there (Changes and Unversioned Files), grouped by file, class and method.
  • Marks added, modified and deleted comments. Deleted comments open in the diff.
  • Filters by comment type: doc, line and block.
  • UI in English and Korean, following the IDE language.
Languages
  • Java, Kotlin, Python: dedicated rules (Python docstrings included).
  • JavaScript, TypeScript (including JSX), Go: classes and functions from the editor breadcrumbs.
  • Other languages with an installed language plugin (XML, YAML, …): all comments are listed. Grouping by class and function depends on the language.

Commit 창에 Comments 탭을 붙여, 거기 오른 파일(Changes·Unversioned Files)의 바뀐 줄에 걸친 주석을 파일·클래스·메서드별로 모아 보여준다. 추가·수정·삭제된 주석을 구분한다.
  • Java·Kotlin·Python: 전용 규칙 (Python docstring 포함)
  • JavaScript·TypeScript(JSX 포함)·Go: 편집기 브레드크럼으로 클래스·함수 판정
  • 그 밖에 언어 플러그인이 설치된 언어(XML·YAML 등): 주석은 다 나오고, 클래스·함수 묶음은 언어마다 다름
